# PROTOTYPE, throwaway: the PR body an AFK agent session writes

Answers [Prototype the PR body an AFK agent session writes](https://github.com/ltowarek/dust-mite/issues/261). Not for `main`.

Seven bodies, `a-actual.md` to `g-minimal.md`, for two merged PRs: #212 (controller, no DUT run) and #183 (car firmware, `needs-car`). `python3 build.py` renders them through GitHub's Markdown API into `index.html`; open it and switch with ← →.

Verdict: vanilla `/pr`, variant B. See the resolution comment on the ticket.
